surface_verification.detail: The REAL production entry point, out of process: `uv run shared/scripts/dev_server.py status --cwd .` through the shim -> package -> CLI path, exit 0 with clean JSON. That is the honest end-to-end check for this change, because the change is at MODULE IMPORT time - if the package stopped importing or dispatching, /shipwright-preview and /shipwright-test break here first. Unit-level pins are covered by F0.
